title: Topic 3
japanese_text: 株式<u>投資</u>は少なからず<u>リスク</u>を伴う。過去の株価<u>変動</u>等を見て投資先について吟味し、<u>賢明な</u>判断をしたい。
english_translation: Investing in stocks involves no small amount of risk. I want to consider my investment options and make wise decisions by looking at past stock price fluctuations and other factors.
